coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: Both search engines returned responses, but indexed hits were predominantly older, generic, international or otherwise irrelevant despite two-day recency constraints, reducing confidence in recall of fresh rural/territorial developments.
coverage_notes.limitations: Supplementary recall, not exhaustive coverage or evidence of no events. Publication time not reliably disclosed for some sources; old announcements with an effective date today cannot be treated as newly confirmed effects without evidence.
coverage_notes.controls: Append-only heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger only; no primary collector, public site, editorial approval, social publication, schedule, or enablement changes.
